title: WRP State Machine
description: Formal 11-state state machine definition for the WorkRequest Protocol. Defines all states, valid transitions, terminal states, and the adjacency matrix.

CREATED.description: WorkRequest has been created but not yet ingested into the system

INTAKE.description: WorkRequest is being ingested — validated, parsed, assigned

PLANNING.description: Decomposition strategy is being defined — steps, dependencies, resources

CRITIQUE.description: Plan is being reviewed — feasibility, constraint checking, risk assessment

SPECIFICATION.description: Detailed specification is being produced — requirements, constraints, success criteria

APPROVED.description: WorkRequest has been formally approved for execution

QUEUED.description: WorkRequest is queued and waiting for an available executor

EXECUTING.description: WorkRequest is actively being executed by an agent

ARCHIVED.description: WorkRequest has been archived — terminal, read-only

FAILED.description: WorkRequest has failed — terminal but may be retried via new version

adjacency_matrix.description: Formal state transition matrix. Rows = from_state, Columns = to_state. 1 = valid transition, 0 = invalid.

failure_model.description: FAILED is reachable from any non-terminal, non-initial state
failure_model.recovery: FAILED WorkRequests may be retried by creating a new version (version incremented, derived_from set to failed WorkRequest)

state_transition_rules.rule: Transitions must be validated against the adjacency matrix before execution
Each transition MUST produce a WRP event recorded in the event store
FAILED WorkRequests may be retried by creating a new version with incremented version field
Terminal states (COMPLETED, ARCHIVED, FAILED) may not transition to any other state
CRITIQUE may transition back to PLANNING for revision
SPECIFICATION may transition back to CRITIQUE for re-review
APPROVED may transition back to SPECIFICATION if changes are required
